old_mapping.defect: 3-byte write placed R at byte0 (mode position), corrupting the mode field -> lighting off
evidence: real global-lighting write is group 0x04 sub 0x01 / report 9 / 63B sendReport
register 0x01 layout is [mode, 0, R, G, B, brightness, speed] (7 bytes)

global_state_block.register_readable_at: feature register 0x01 (GET group 0x84 sub 0x01 returns the same 7 bytes)
global_state_block.scope: global lighting only (mode/RGB/brightness/speed); NOT per-key RGB / edge lighting / advanced
global_state_block.evidence: brightness changes preserve mode+RGB+speed; color changes preserve mode+brightness+speed; speed changes preserve mode+RGB+brightness

device_echo.semantics: write acceptance/echo (identical inputreport after each sendReport)
device_echo.classification: ACK/ECHO — NOT authoritative current-state readback; does not substitute K13 baseline GET

light.mode.unresolved: effect enum 01/02/03 internally ambiguous (BREATHING->01/02 overlap; STATIC/ANIMATED overlap) — no effect-name assigned

light.enable.model: mode=0 -> OFF; ON = selecting a non-zero mode; turning OFF requires previous mode known

light.brightness.step: PARTIAL (25-pt samples only; finer UI step not proven)

0x86.label: fetch_custom_light (GET)
0x86.status: NOT_SEEN / sub0 returns echo; may be per-key/custom-light GET

0x04/0x01.label: device_setting.sync register 0x01 light_mode (SET) — REAL global-lighting write

k13_baseline: CLOSED (current global lighting state obtainable read-only via GET register 0x01: [mode,0,R,G,B,brightness,speed])
k14_rollback: OPEN (rollback not physically tested; Probe writes forbidden until authorized; needs write+echo+final GET verification)
